name: Cloning
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator who made humanity in His own image, male and female, and entrusted them with dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:26-28). This divine design affirms that human life is uniquely fashioned by God, who intimately forms each person even in the womb (Psalms 139:13). Recognizing that we are made by God and not by ourselves (Psalms 100:3) challenges any human attempt to replicate life apart from His creative authority, including human cloning.
